title: On the Ball Covering Property of $\mathbb{L}(\mathbb{X}, \mathbb{Y})$
summary: We investigate the Ball Covering Property (BCP) of Banach spaces through the lens of Birkhoff-James orthogonality, yielding a new geometric characterization of the property. Applying this framework, we characterize the BCP of the bounded linear operator space $\mathbb{L}(\mathbb{X}, \mathbb{Y})$ under specific conditions on $\mathbb{X}$ and $\mathbb{Y}$, proving that an earlier necessary condition is sufficient.
